feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 7 June 2026 5:55am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 07 June 2026 at 5:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds soon developing.


##Synopsis##

High pressure over France and an area of low pressure to the northwest of the British Isles.


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5 soon increasing 5 or 6, occasionally 7 this afternoon, decreasing 4 or 5 early tonight, then veering west or northwest 3 or 4 later tonight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate becoming moderate or rough this afternoon. Falling slight again later tonight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair to start, then rain arriving from the southwest later morning and afternoon, heavy at times later. Clearing to become mainly fair later in the night.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, then falling moderate or poor in rain this afternoon and evening.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or northwest 3 or 4, backing southwest Monday afternoon, increasing 4 or 5 Monday evening, increasing 5 or 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight building moderate later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, showers developing later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers later.
